linguacraft.alphabet.hint: Click a letter to see how it sounds.
linguacraft.alphabet.learned: %s of %s letters learned in this group
linguacraft.alphabet.note.ko.g_k: Between g and k. At the end of a syllable, like k.
linguacraft.alphabet.note.ko.d_t: Between d and t. At the end of a syllable, like t.
linguacraft.alphabet.note.ko.r_l: A light flapped r. At the end of a syllable, like l.
linguacraft.alphabet.note.ko.b_p: Between b and p. At the end of a syllable, like p.
linguacraft.alphabet.note.ko.s: Like s in sun. Before ㅣ, like sh.
linguacraft.alphabet.note.ko.ng: Silent at the start of a syllable. At the end, ng.
linguacraft.alphabet.note.ko.ch: Like ch in chair, with a puff of air.
linguacraft.alphabet.note.ko.k: Like k, with a puff of air.
linguacraft.alphabet.note.ko.t: Like t, with a puff of air.
linguacraft.alphabet.note.ko.p: Like p, with a puff of air.
linguacraft.alphabet.note.ko.kk: A tense k, with no puff of air.
linguacraft.alphabet.note.ko.tt: A tense t, with no puff of air.
linguacraft.alphabet.note.ko.pp: A tense p, with no puff of air.
linguacraft.alphabet.note.ko.jj: A tense j, with no puff of air.
linguacraft.alphabet.note.ko.eo: Like u in up, with the mouth open.
linguacraft.alphabet.note.ko.yeo: The ㅓ sound with y before it.
linguacraft.alphabet.note.ko.o: Like o in go, without the glide.
linguacraft.alphabet.note.ko.eu: Like oo, without rounding the lips.
linguacraft.alphabet.note.ko.e: Now sounds almost the same as ㅐ.
linguacraft.alphabet.note.ko.oe: Now sounds like we in wet.
linguacraft.alphabet.note.ko.we: Now sounds almost the same as ㅙ.
linguacraft.alphabet.note.ko.ui: The ㅡ sound followed by ㅣ.
linguacraft.alphabet.note.ja.fu: Between f and h, blowing through the lips.
linguacraft.alphabet.note.ja.n: Said on its own, as a whole syllable.
